study_notes.title: Temporary Magnetism: The Electric Bell
study_notes.electromagnets: Magnets that only work when electricity flows. Strength increases by: 1. More coils, 2. More current, 3. Using a soft iron core.

electric_bell_cycle.visual_reference: [IMAGE_024: Step-by-step cycle diagram of an electric bell]
electric_bell_cycle.Step_1: Switch is pressed, current flows, electromagnet attracts the armature.
electric_bell_cycle.Step_3: As armature moves, it breaks contact with the screw, stopping the current.
electric_bell_cycle.Step_4: Magnet loses force; spring pulls armature back to touch the screw.
electric_bell_cycle.Step_5: Cycle repeats as long as the button is held.

IMAGE_024.description: A 4-part circular diagram showing the movement of the hammer and the breaking of the circuit contact.
